# Authored catalogue fixtures

All files in this directory are independently authored for Turnout and are
licensed GPL-3.0-only. They contain no redistributed XTrackCAD parameter data.
`system-a.xtp` has four deliberately small supported definitions; `system-b.xtp`
contains a colliding number at a different scale. The tests define the exact
expected geometry, routes, completeness, and diagnostic behavior. Checksums are
recorded by release verification after fixtures are finalized.
